# fulmenhq issue and pull request templates

Adapted from [3 Leaps OSS policies](https://github.com/3leaps/oss-policies).
These templates provide concise bug reports, feature requests, questions, and
pull requests for fulmenhq repositories that do not define their own templates.

Keep contact links absolute and public: these files can be presented in other
repositories. Do not require labels unless they exist in every consuming
repository. Do not link to Discussions unless that destination is enabled.

Review upstream template changes deliberately, preserving fulmenhq public
support and policy links. See the [repository README](../README.md) for how
GitHub applies defaults.
